prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Bauchan, hairy Scottish domestic hobgoblin with extraordinary strength.
ANATOMY: ONE hairy humanoid hobgoblin, one head, TWO eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs, shaggy dark hair across face and forearms [bauchan-c04]; fully opaque coarse brown tunic and trousers. Natural weathered face, no horns, wings, tail or invented anatomy.
MOMENT: Drag a massive freshly felled tree trunk right up against a farmhouse doorway, both hands grip trunk and face turns toward viewer in fierce mischievous grin; trunk knocks door open and makes dust jump.
POWER: Extraordinary strength [bauchan-c07]; delivered wished-for felled tree so house shook and door rattled [bauchan-c11]. Physical tree weight and rattling door, no magic beams.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; tight close camera, subject fills square, no undocumented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant amber lamp or low moon, deep walnut shadows, hard rim light; ordinary physical dust or wind.
SURFACE: tactile weathered skin, coarse cloth, matted fur, wood and stone; premium painterly brushwork, no plastic.
SETTING: Small rocky farm near Loch Traig, Lochaber [bauchan-c08,bauchan-c11].
MOOD: imposing and active; never cute, calm or decorative. Preserve helpful beings as helpful and worshipped deities as dignified and reverential.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Bauchan, hairy Scottish domestic hobgoblin with extraordinary strength

visual_requirements.description: Extraordinary strength delivering felled tree; house shakes and door rattles

aura: Documented form and action dominate through low framing and physical light; no aura.
artistic_choices: Choose hairy humanoid rather than goat or separate headless Coluinn tale. Tree dimensions/garments editorial; helpful but forceful grin.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: hairy hobgoblin with one head/two eyes, two arms gripping tree, two legs; huge felled trunk shoved against farm doorway produces physical chips and dust. Close low camera gives dominance without giant claim. Grinning helpful strength rather than evil; no text/aura/borrowed design. All seven Sangar criteria pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px. A shaggy, hairy Scottish hobgoblin with a wild beard and a broad grin (c04/c11), two hairy arms and two legs in opaque coarse clothing, hauling an entire felled tree trunk against the rattling door of a lit stone farmhouse (the c11 moment). The superhuman strength feat plus the hairy, uncanny wild-man design give clear mythic distinction — not an ordinary man — set beside a moonlit Lochaber loch with a cottage (c08). Dominates the frame at 200px; no invented magic, text or borrowed design.
